entries.040d2e7ebfbcef9f: A reportable segment that mainly engages in the import and export of aviation-related materials and other goods, and in retail stores and mail-order sales. It is carried out by subsidiaries centered on ANA TRADING CO., LTD., and these goods are also sold to subsidiaries and affiliates within the corporate group as customers. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥132,933 million, making it the reportable segment next after the air transportation business; sales including intersegment sales were ¥154,249 million (up 18.7% from the previous fiscal year), and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥7,557 million (up 65.6%), the largest profit outside the air transportation business. Segment assets were ¥83,448 million and the number of employees was 1,378. The company explains that, in addition to the strong performance of the tourist souvenir wholesale business "FUJISEY" owing to the effect of the Osaka-Kansai Expo, handling volumes increased in the electronics business related to security equipment for logistics companies and semiconductors. The main companies are ANA TRADING CO., LTD., ANA Foods Co., Ltd., ANA FESTA Co., Ltd., ANA TRADING Duty Free Co., Ltd. and FUJISEY Co., Ltd.

entries.0991e981a150cd9c: The third brand of the air transportation business, operated by Air Japan Co., Ltd., which began operations in February 2024. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥13,935 million (up 19.0% from the previous fiscal year), the number of passengers was 499,915 (up 16.7%), and the load factor was 72.6%. The company states that it will suspend the AirJapan brand as of March 2026 and consolidate its aircraft and personnel into ANA brand operations, and that it will restructure into a dual-brand strategy of the ANA brand and the Peach brand going forward.
entries.1864ed1a5955bbac: A reportable segment that provides services incidental to air transportation, such as airport handling and maintenance. ANA Osaka Airport Co., Ltd., ANA Airport Services Co., Ltd., ANA Telemart Co., Ltd., ANA Base Maintenance Techniques Co., Ltd. and others provide customers with various services at airports, telephone reservation guidance, and maintenance work services for aircraft operated in the air transportation business. Services such as airport ground support and maintenance work are also provided to airlines in Japan and overseas other than the corporate group. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥60,219 million, but there were internal sales or transfers between segments of ¥301,400 million, and sales including these were ¥361,619 million (up 7.2% from the previous fiscal year), which indicates that airlines within the group are the main customers. Segment profit (operating profit) was ¥1,456 million (down 63.9%), which the company explains was due to increased personnel expenses and other costs. The number of employees was 21,736, exceeding the 20,608 of the air transportation business and the largest among the 4 reportable segments.

entries.45233141513c78b1: This is cargo transportation and mail transportation under the ANA brand. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, international cargo revenue was ¥184,125 million (down 1.7% from the previous year), cargo transported was 726,637 tons (up 3.2%), the cargo weight load factor was 57.5%, and domestic cargo revenue was ¥22,834 million. Mail revenue was ¥4,353 million on international routes and ¥2,432 million on domestic routes. The company explains that for international cargo, transported weight exceeded the previous year because it strengthened the intake of cargo from Asia to North America, but revenue fell below the previous year because demand for automobile-related goods and E-commerce declined, among other factors. It states that, using both the lower-deck cargo holds (belly) of passenger flights and freighters, it flexibly adjusted freighter routes and capacity after assessing demand trends.
entries.47b17221ee970f76: A cargo airline that connects Japan with Europe and North America using large dedicated freighters. Through a share exchange based on a resolution of the Board of Directors on July 10, 2023, the company acquired all shares effective August 1, 2025, and it became a wholly owned subsidiary; its results from July 1, 2025, the deemed acquisition date, to March 31, 2026 are consolidated. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, cargo revenue was ¥108,963 million and other revenue was ¥26,701 million, totaling ¥135,664 million; cargo transported weighed 313,082 tons and the cargo weight load factor was 64.0%. The company states that it was affected by reduced demand for third-country cargo from China to North America due to U.S. tariff policy, but strengthened the capture of cargo from Asia to Europe and North America and other cargo. The Narita–Frankfurt route was opened from September, and codeshare with ANA on routes to Europe and North America began in October. The company states that the extensive cargo and passenger flight network of the ANA Group has been combined with the network and know-how of NCA's large dedicated freighters, and that the reorganization and integration of the cargo business companies within the group is scheduled for April 2027.
entries.47f42bba60de6927: This is the LCC (low-cost carrier) segment, carried out by Peach Aviation Limited. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥143,320 million (up 2.9% from the previous year), the number of passengers was 9,456,675 (up 3.9%), passenger-kilometers were 11,278,281 thousand, and the load factor was 84.3%. The company explains that inbound travel demand and leisure demand remained solid. It newly opened the Kansai–Gimpo and Chubu–Gimpo routes in April, increased flights on both routes from August, and raised the Kansai–Gimpo route to 4 round trips per 1 day in February 2026. It renewed its website in April and introduced an "auto check-in" function from December. The company became a consolidated subsidiary in April 2017 and integrated its business with Vanilla Air Inc. in October 2019. The amount of liabilities in excess of assets as of the end of March 2026 was ¥37,709 million.

entries.923104f7a75f1c96: Provision of maintenance work services for aircraft operated in the air transportation business. It is carried out by ANA Base Maintenance Techniques Co., Ltd., ANA Component Techniques Co., Ltd., ANA Engine Techniques Co., Ltd., ANA Line Maintenance Techniques Co., Ltd., ANA Aero Supply System Co., Ltd. and others, and includes MRO Japan Co., Ltd. of Naha, Okinawa Prefecture (45.0% of voting rights held). Maintenance work and other services are also provided to airlines in Japan and overseas other than the corporate group. ANA Base Maintenance Techniques Co., Ltd. was established in October 1970 as All Nippon Airways Maintenance Co., Ltd.
entries.94e0fddcce99f518: Operations that handle passengers, baggage, cargo and aircraft at airports. They are carried out by companies for each airport, such as ANA Airport Services Co., Ltd., ANA Osaka Airport Co., Ltd., ANA Kansai Airport Co., Ltd. and ANA Narita Airport Services Co., Ltd., and are also provided to airlines in Japan and overseas other than the corporate group. The company explains that in the fiscal year ended March 2026, contracted in-flight meal-related services from foreign airlines increased and the handling volume of international cargo expanded. For the domestic passenger business, it states that it will also advance collaboration with Japan Airlines Co., Ltd. in the airport handling area to improve efficiency.

entries.b91e5c0a56892b21: Domestic passenger transportation under the ANA brand. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, passenger revenue was ¥738,013 million (up 4.8% from the previous fiscal year) and the number of passengers was 45,635,143 (up 3.6%); it carries 5 times as many passengers as international flights, but because distances are shorter, its revenue is lower than that of international passengers. Revenue passenger kilometers were 36,780,474 thousand passenger-kilometers, the load factor was 79.2% (75.0% in the previous fiscal year), and the number of flights operated was 371,573. The company explains that it continuously held fare sales for the ANA brand to stimulate leisure demand and capture it early. From October, frequencies were increased on routes such as Haneda–New Chitose and Haneda–Fukuoka, and extra flights were scheduled mainly in peak demand periods, while supply was matched to demand by means such as using smaller aircraft. Passenger results include codeshare flights with Ibex Airlines Co., Ltd., AIRDO Co., Ltd., Solaseed Air Inc. and Starflyer Inc.

entries.bcde7f85be396931: A category conducting building management, staffing and other businesses; the company notes that it is a business segment not included in the reportable segments and includes facility management, business support and other businesses. ANA Sky Building Service Co., Ltd. conducts building maintenance, and ANA Business Solution Co., Ltd. conducts staffing and similar services. Also included are ANA Facilities Co., Ltd., ANA Research Institute Co., Ltd., avatarin Inc. and others. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥19,209 million, sales including inter-segment sales were ¥49,728 million (up 9.3% from the previous year), segment profit (operating profit) was ¥2,276 million (up 97.7%), segment assets were ¥36,454 million, and the number of employees was 2,379. The company explains that handling volume increased in building and facility maintenance and management and in real estate-related businesses. In the fiscal year, this category recorded an impairment loss on fixed assets of ¥292 million. Because it is not a reportable segment, it is placed last rather than in a position reflecting sales below the travel business.

entries.ec289bc2c6312ffa: A reportable segment centered on developing and selling travel products, planning and selling package tours and similar products. ANA X Co., Ltd. plans and sells package tours and similar products under the "ANA Travelers" brand that incorporate air tickets and other products of All Nippon Airways Co., Ltd. Overseas, ANA Sales Americas and others provide various services at the destination to travelers who bought package products sold by the domestic company, and also sell air tickets and travel products. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥50,154 million and sales including inter-segment sales were ¥65,332 million (down 11.2% from the previous year); package product revenue was ¥33,180 million domestic and ¥6,201 million international. Segment profit was an operating loss of ¥146 million (operating profit of ¥193 million in the previous year), the only loss among the 4 reportable segments. The company explains that for overseas travel, it captured demand mainly for Hawaii and Europe and handling volume increased, while for domestic travel, sales of components such as "ANA Travelers Hotel" were strong but customer attraction for the main dynamic package products was sluggish. In the fiscal year, this segment recorded an impairment loss on fixed assets of ¥3,121 million. It has started "ANA Gas," a new infrastructure service, and "ANA Mobile," a mobile communication service. The number of employees is 1,439.
entries.ede37f92a5feab5e: International passenger transportation under the ANA brand. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, passenger revenue was ¥878,977 million (up 9.1% from the previous fiscal year), the largest revenue item within the air transportation business; the number of passengers was 9,023,150 (up 11.8%), revenue passenger kilometers were 51,307,355 thousand passenger-kilometers, available seat kilometers were 61,835,497 thousand seat-kilometers, and the load factor was 83.0% (79.2% in the previous fiscal year). The number of international flights operated was 53,625. The company explains that it actively captured inbound demand and leisure demand from Japan, and that routes to Europe performed well, in particular because three new European routes were launched from the second half of fiscal 2024. Frequencies were increased on the Narita–Hong Kong route from October, on the Haneda–Hong Kong, Narita–Perth and Narita–Mumbai routes from December, and on the Narita–Brussels route from March 2026. A joint venture agreement was concluded with Singapore Airlines, and sales of joint fares began in May. In March 2026, the company marked the 40th anniversary of the launch of its scheduled international flights.
